run_simulation_run_simulation: run the torax simulation with a given config and return simulation results and state history
run_simulation_run_simulation_max_steps: run the torax simulation with a limited max_steps to trigger DID_NOT_REACH_T_FINAL error
output_load_state_file: load a netCDF state file into an xarray DataTree for reference comparison
output_stitch_state_files: stitch a restart state file to the beginning of a reference dataset using torax_config.restart
torax_config_update_fields: update torax config fields such as profile_conditions.nbar and rerun simulation to verify changed output
